description: Example authored rationale. These lines are demonstration text, NOT evidence of a real designer's decisions. Optionally attach existing WAV files with an 'audio' field per step.

steps.why: The base footprint is wide enough to support the phone while minimizing material.
The back support height is adjustable because the viewing position depends on the device.
The lip needs to prevent sliding without covering the lower part of the screen.
Bevel exposed edges to improve handling and reduce sharp contacts.
